episodes.synopsis: Senku e Kohaku sorvegliano dall'alto l'area intorno al Regno della scienza in cerca di risorse per l'attraversata oceanica accompagnati da Ryusui.
episodes.title: New World Map

episodes.synopsis: Ryusui resta deluso dalla pessima cucina di Senku e decide di risvegliare il suo fedele maggiordomo nonché abile cuoco Francois. Senku vuole del pane a lunga conservazione.
episodes.title: Voglio = Giusto

episodes.synopsis: Senku scatta delle foto dalla mongolfiera nella speranza di trovare il petrolio, ma inutilmente. Francois e Suika usano le foto per localizzare del cibo gourmet.
episodes.title: First Contact

episodes.synopsis: Senku e i suoi amici si mettono al lavoro per creare un radar e un sonar nel tentativo di trovare un modo per localizzare la fonte dell'inquietante messaggio in codice Morse.
episodes.title: Gli occhi della scienza

episodes.synopsis: Senku e gli abitanti del villaggio iniziano a costruire un grande veliero, ma incontrano un problema apparentemente insormontabile. Ryusui trova una soluzione intelligente.
episodes.title: La nave della Scienza, Perseus

episodes.synopsis: La nave della scienza Perseus naviga alla ricerca della navetta spaziale Soyuz, dove Senku crede che il suo equipaggio troverà una scorta di minerali preziosi, tra cui il platino.
episodes.title: Treasure Box

episodes.synopsis: Subito dopo l'arrivo sull'isola, Senku guida una piccola squadra alla ricerca di platino. Ukyo e Ginro fanno una scoperta allarmante sul fondo del mare.
episodes.title: La luce della disperazione e della speranza

episodes.synopsis: Senku e il resto del gruppo vengono a conoscenza dell'arma pietrificante e pensano a un piano per rubarla con tanto di Kohaku debitamente truccata.
episodes.title: L'asso nella manica è sulla nave della Scienza

episodes.synopsis: Mentre gli isolani cercano la Perseus, Suika distrae Ginro per portare il laboratorio mobile dalla nave a Senku.
episodes.title: Lo splendore della scienza

episodes.synopsis: Kohaku riceve istruzioni tramite un auricolare mentre il suo gruppo s'infiltra nel campo principale del nemico. Senku e gli altri costruiscono un motore elettromagnetico.
episodes.title: Science Wars

episodes.synopsis: Una sgomenta Kohaku scopre che la capsula Soyuz è bloccata nel cemento. Senku trova un modo per spaccarlo senza fare rumore.
episodes.title: Un miracolo con il mio pugno

episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Vivid memories are triggered when Yukiya meets a woman who already knows his secret. She has a request that only he can fulfill.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: The original video that started this whole mess is deleted, but it’s too late: It’s already gone viral. Meanwhile, old friends gather and discuss Yukiya’s situation.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Yukiya learns about Tazuna and does not approve of his actions. When Haruka later offers him concert tickets, Yukiya realizes the date conflicts with a prior engagement.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Tazuna has returned, and his power forces Yukiya’s foes to retreat. What wisdom does this living legend have to teach Yukiya?
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: The battle against Hana and Senri reaches a climax. Just what is the Composer up to?
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Yukiya’s decided—He will perform as himself instead of his alias for the upcoming music festival. Later, there’s something Tazuna wishes to discuss with him.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Koyori encourages Haruka to be true to her feelings. Tazuna informs his allies that the Okuike Group has plans for Ziggurat.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Yukiya receives an unexpected call from a representative of the Okuike Group. Midori wants to meet and explain what he’s after.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Reiji’s not going to sit on the sidelines when his son needs him. He’s coming along to help Yukiya save Haruka because that’s what parents do.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Yukiya and Haruka face off against their greatest challenge yet. DJ Nielsen, another irregular, is in their way And he’s not alone - Tazuna and Koyori stand with him!
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: It’s time to end this, once and for all. Who has the strongest will to see their wish fulfilled?

info.synopsis: Yukiya, che si dice abbia 14 anni, ha una passione per la musica house, che gli è stata trasmessa sin dalla primissima infanzia dal padre DJ. Egli passa il suo tempo a mixare in solitudine e carica i suoi pezzi online su dei video. Vuole trasmettere la sua passione al pubblico, spera che il suo talento venga riconosciuto e mira a diventare famoso. Ma il mondo di internet non è tenero, pullula di leoni da tastiera, veloci a criticare ed insultate; rimanere delusi è feriti è facilissimo. Venire feriti nell'orgoglio è davvero spaventoso, così un giorno, per tentare di ottenere più visualizzazioni, Yukiya fa qualcosa che non può più essere disfatto… assiste ad una diretta live da “quel mondo”…
info.title: W'z

info.title: Castlevania: Nocturne (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: When an exhausted office worker drops dead at her doorstep from overwork, she has but one humble wish for her next life... To be able to pet all of the cuddly creatures she can find! Welcome to a paradise of fluff (that may be home to a few secrets)!
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: After an extraordinary demonstration of her ability to bond with animals, Neema is in for... extraordinary consequences? The king expects an explanation, and everyone is watching closely!
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Neema is enjoying the chance to see and experience the wide variety of animals kept in service of the palace, and next, she's off for a birthday excursion into the city! What surprises will await?
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Neema gets a private tutor, and the immediate friction between them is palpable. Something about the seemingly perfect woman just isn't right, and Neema's determined to figure out what on her own terms.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Neema's father takes her on a tour of their northern lands, where unusual monsters have been appearing in the forest and causing problems for the locals lately.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Neema is now deep in the forest and deep in trouble. Her father has arrived to rescue her from the terrible clutches... of the goblins she's just made friends with! Can she smooth things over, especially with real danger lurking around the corner?
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Neema shares with her father her plan for humans and monsters to coexist. Will the new town they visit on their inspection tour make things easier or that much more complicated?
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Ralf arrives to take over the inspection on his father's behalf, and he immediately gets drawn into Neema's plan too! Next stop? The epicenter of the kobold attacks, of course! Neema has plans for even them!
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Neema and company set out into the woods in hopes of returning the pup they've found and striking a peaceful deal with the kobolds, but they may end up making a few more friends than they bargained for!
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Neema has finally made it to the kobold colony, but winning their trust will be another ordeal altogether! In order to get them in on her plan, it's time for a big meeting!
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: The battle to save the kobolds is nigh. Neema must now face the decisions she's made, for better or worse. If the plan is going to succeed, they'll need a strong leader, teamwork, and a whole lot of fluffs!
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Now that the dust is settling on the fight to save the kobolds, Neema must stop and take stock of everything that's happened... and how much further she must go.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Midori Akitsu (27 anni), finisce in un altro mondo dopo essere morta a causa del superlavoro! Dopo la reincarnzazione scopre di possedere un'abilità speciale: "essere amata da esseri non umani". Potrà accarezzare tranquillamente una tigre bianca o un drago! Dopo essere rinata come Néma, questa figlia più giovane di una famiglia nobile di alto rango, fa del suo meglio per la sopravvivenza dell'umanità e intanto si gode la morbidezza delle creature di questo mondo.
info.title: Fluffy Paradise

info.synopsis: In uno scenario post apocalittico, abbandonati in una società reduce dalla Guerra Mondiale, due soldati mercenari - Deunan e il suo partner cyborg Briareos - vengono incaricati di portare a termine una missione alla periferia della loro città devastata. Durante l'operazione s'imbattono in Iris e Olson, due cittadini della mitica città di Olympus, che forse sanno come salvare il mondo.
info.title: Appleseed Alpha

episodes.synopsis: A boy and his Arnval Shinki, nicknamed Ann, move to his hometown in Japan to start high school. As Ann helps unpack her master's things whilst he is at school, his other Shinki, Ines and Lene, help her out and discover a box labelled 'Important'. After tidying up the place, they inadvertently send a knife flying into the 'Important' box and decide to check the contents, finding a love letter inside. When the wind suddenly blows the letter away, the Shinki chase after it as it knocks over another Shinki named Kurara, who takes it as a challenge and forces them into a battlefield. When the letter becomes slightly damaged as a result of the battle, Ann becomes angry and overhwelms Kurara in battle before heading back home. After their master returns from school, Ann apologises for what happened to the letter, which is revealed to contain a visualizer containing a house he made for Ann when he was little. Later, they discover another box containing a Strarf model Shinki.
episodes.title: I Found Something Important

episodes.synopsis: The Strarf unit, which was a surprise gift from the master's father, is named Hina. As Hina becomes wary of a presence nearby, she becomes downhearted when she learns her master isn't all that into battling. Later that night, Ann suggests to Ines and Lene that they prepare a feast for their master's high school entrance gift. However, things start to get messy when a pair of cat-type Shinki start interfering. Things soon get suspenseful when the fuse shorts out and the Shinki find themselves attacked by a live octopus. Luckily, Hina comes in to save the day, stopping the octopus and fighting back the perpetrators whilst managing to get dinner ready in the process.
episodes.title: The Secret Ingredient is the Scent of Gunpowder

episodes.synopsis: Kurara shows up at the Shinkis' home asking for their assistance in catching a thief that has been stealing Shinki units. As Hina decides to accompany her, they tail a suspicious person to a Shinki store. Meanwhile, the master is taken in for questioning, prompting Ann, Ines and Lene to set off in order to clear his name. Noticing he is being watched, the suspicious person activates two Shinki, Ach and Yda, against Hina and Kurara. As Ines and Lene chase after the thief, Ann goes to assist Hina in fighting Ach and Yda. The battle is soon put to a halt when Ach and Yda learn that their master is the true thief who manipulated them into fighting for him. As Ach and Yda head off on a journey to find a more suitable master, the thief is brought to justice and the master's charges are dropped.
episodes.title: Crash! Battle Trike

episodes.synopsis: Lene and Ines are on the outs, and their Master has the itch to travel. A race aorund the park promises a trip to Okinawa for the winning Shinki and their Master, and Ines along with Lene enter...as well as few surprise entrants too.
episodes.title: It's a Race! Once Around the Park

episodes.synopsis: Ann and the rest of the Shinki prepare for a trip to Okinawa with their Master...who unfortunately leaves them behind while running late. The girls then decide to make their way to the small island in search of fun and sun.
episodes.title: Beach Swimsuit Armor

episodes.synopsis: While on a return trip from Okinawa, the Ann & Co. encounter a trio of Shinkis who have hijacked the plane and are sending it on a one way trip to hell.
episodes.title: Attention, Please! Our Plane is Bound for Hell

episodes.synopsis: Seeking a cool place to relax, the Shinkis inexplicably end up huddling around a room full of candles, telling horror stories in hopes of scaring the heat away. As the weather suddenly shifts to a downpour, the Shinkis go out searching for their master and encounter something not of this world...or so they think.
episodes.title: The Visitor Comes with the Sound of Rain...

episodes.synopsis: One day, Ann wakes up as a human. When Rihito sees her pouting in the park, he decides to do the gentlemanly thing and help her out. Meanwhile, Ann’s Shinki body has been infected by a potentially fatal virus!
episodes.title: Someday, Somewhere

episodes.synopsis: The evil Shinki Cloudy rules the underground empire that is home to rogue Shinki. Lene swears that she will help the Liberation Army fight for freedom... while searching for her master’s missing rice ball.
episodes.title: Lene's War Against the Underground Empire

episodes.synopsis: Ann, Hina, Ines, and Lene are all looking for a job to help pay for a christmas present for their master that they found while out browsing the shops
episodes.title: A Christmas Song For You

episodes.synopsis: The girls try and plan something for HIna's birthday. Later, HIna is taken away and memories are forcibly erased.
episodes.title: We'll Settle It Tonight! Who is the Strongest Shinki?!

episodes.synopsis: The girls go out to track down and get Hina back.
episodes.title: Don't Say "Goodbye"

info.synopsis: La serie è ambientata in un ipotetico futuro ove il progresso della tecnologia ha reso comunemente disponibili per gli esseri umani dei robot per la loro vita quotidiana. Tra questi ci sono proprio le "Shinki" dei robot dalle fattezze femminili alti circa 15 centimetri che si rivolgono devotamente al loro padrone chiamandolo "Master".
info.title: Busou Shinki: Armored War Goddess

episodes.synopsis: When Usami Ichika tries to bake a cake for her mother, she's visited by a helpful fairy and a troublemaking monster! To save her cake, she must transform into the legendary pâtissier, Cure Whip!
episodes.title: Full of Love! Cure Whip, Ready to Serve!

episodes.synopsis: Ichika bonds with shy Arisugawa Himari over a mutual love of purin. Though Arisugawa fears her passion for sweets might scare her new friend away, it comes in handy when she transforms into Cure Custard!
episodes.title: The Little Genius, Cure Custard!

episodes.synopsis: Ichika and Himari are head-over-heels for the hardcore rocker, Tategami Aoi. But when a monster tries to interrupt her concert, Aoi transforms into the electric Cure Gelato!
episodes.title: Roar, Lion! Cure Gelato!

episodes.synopsis: The three new best friends decide to bake an extra-special treat for their favorite ballerina. But is the recipe for cream puffs biting off more than they can chew?!
episodes.title: Three Girls United! Let's La Mix-It-Up!

episodes.synopsis: Kotozume Yukari is the most beautiful girl in her school, exceptionally talented... and bored with everything. But when she finds herself taking a liking to Ichika, she winds up as her newest ally, Cure Macaron!
episodes.title: That Capricious Young Lady Is Cure Macaron!

episodes.synopsis: When kind and dreamy Kenjo Akira moves in next door, Ichika starts to feel things she's never felt before... but after making chocolate together, she's shocked to see her new crush transform into Cure Chocolat!
episodes.title: Is This Love?! The Glorious Cure Chocolat!

episodes.synopsis: Reminiscing about her missing fairy friends has Pekorin feeling blue. To cheer her up, Ichika proposes a donut party on the mountain!
episodes.title: Pekorin Makes Donuts, Peko!

episodes.synopsis: Ichika wants her friends to open their own pâtisserie! But as they assign roles and get to work, nothing seems to go right...
episodes.title: The KiraPâti's Opening... Isn't Happening!

episodes.synopsis: The KiraPâti is open for business... but nobody's coming! Will baking cookies for a lovelorn young man help to turn their luck around?
episodes.title: The KiraPâti Will Make Your Love Come True!

episodes.synopsis: Akira and Yukari are the stars of the KiraPâti, but when Ichika sends them out to buy toppings for the perfect fruit tart, their natural differences assert themselves.
episodes.title: Yukari vs. Akira! A Tempestuous Errand!

episodes.synopsis: The KiraPâti has a booth in the town's sweets festival! But Gummy and his gang are back, and they're hungry... for the town's entire supply of kirakiral!
episodes.title: Showdown! Precure vs. the Gummy Gang!

episodes.synopsis: A cool and mysterious transfer student, Kuroki Rio, arrives at Ichika's school. Meanwhile, a new threat arrives to challenge the Precures: the sinister masked Julio!
episodes.title: The Enemy Is... the Popular Exchange Student?!

episodes.synopsis: The local greengrocer thinks Himari is the perfect person to do PR for Ichigozaka Shopping Street! But will her fear of sharing her passion hold her back from it?
episodes.title: Can't Do It! Himari's Unexpected Debut!

episodes.synopsis: Aoi is snatched away in the middle of a concert... by her family butler?! Rock 'n' roll is Aoi's only outlet from her restrictive upbringing, and if Ichika can't help, she might lose it forever!
episodes.title: Rich Girl Rock 'n' Roll!

episodes.synopsis: Akira's sister Miku gets a reprieve from the hospital to visit the KiraPâti! While Akira frets about Miku's health, Miku seems desperate to find a way to show her appreciation for Akira.
episodes.title: For the Sake of Love! The Angry Cure Chocolat!

episodes.synopsis: Yukari invites the girls to a tea ceremony at her traditional home... and sets a trap for Julio!
episodes.title: A Dangerously Sudden Approach! Yukari and Rio!

episodes.synopsis: Julio sets his manipulative sights on the leader of the Precures: Cure Whip! Can Ichika's love for her mother win the day?!
episodes.title: The Final Experiment! Cure Whip Can't Transform!

episodes.synopsis: While the Precure girls struggle with a nasty rumor about their shop, Master Noir sends a new envoy to rustle up kirakiral in Ichigozaka: the cynical trickster Bibli!
episodes.title: The Source of the Rumors Is the Powerful Bibli!

episodes.synopsis: Parisian sweets prodigy Kirahoshi Ciel arrives in Ichigozaka, and Ichika is determined to become her disciple!
episodes.title: The Pâtissier Prodigy! Kirahoshi Ciel!

episodes.synopsis: Ciel decides to give Ichika a lesson in fine ingredients with a trip through the mountains. But a sweet visit to a honey farm is interrupted by a Bibli attack!
episodes.title: Admiration Mix-It-Up! Ichika and Ciel!

episodes.synopsis: The fairies have returned to Mt. Ichigo! Ichika and the others head there to celebrate, but... wait, why is Ciel there, too?!
episodes.title: Say What?! Ciel's Identity Revealed!

episodes.synopsis: When Julio returns to vent his hatred on the Precures, Ciel reveals the secret connection they share.
episodes.title: Stop It, Julio! The Kirakiral of Hatred!

episodes.synopsis: When Ciel tries desperately to make amends with Julio, she's carried off by Noir... and a new Precure is born!
episodes.title: Fly! The Rainbow Pegasus, Cure Parfait!

episodes.synopsis: Ciel transfers to the girls' school to strengthen their bonds as a team. But the brutish Glaive rolls up in Ichigozaka to steal kirakiral en masse!
episodes.title: The Transfer Student Is the Fairy Kirarin?!

episodes.synopsis: A visiting prince decides to make Yukari his bride, and Yukari seems to entertain the possibility. Akira's objections just end up with her wrapped in the affair... as a rival for Yukari's affections!
episodes.title: A Whirlwind Marriage?! Princess Yukari!

episodes.synopsis: An innocent trip to the beach ends up with the KiraPâti girls stranded on a deserted island! In their quest to find enough kirakiral to get home, they run into an old rival who's just as stuck as they are.
episodes.title: Summer! The Beach! The KiraPâti Gets Stranded!

episodes.synopsis: Aoi gets her dream: to appear in a rock festival with her idol, Misaki! But can Aoi sing her heart out when the two are pitted against each other?
episodes.title: The Hot Live Battle! Aoi vs. Misaki!

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious professor whisks Himari away to be his assistant in creating history's biggest sponge cake. Will she rise to the challenge, or will her on-stage debut be a flop?!
episodes.title: Rise! Himari's Big Sweets Experiment!

episodes.synopsis: Yukari finds herself feeling pensive over her own capricious personality, and the sinister new foe, Elysio, offers her a window into her soul.
episodes.title: Emergency! Cure Macaron, Stained in Darkness!

episodes.synopsis: When Miku joins the KiraPâti girls at the cultural festival at Yukari and Akira's school, Elysio offers Akira a terrible ultimatum.
episodes.title: The Targeted School Festival! Chocolat in Wonderland!

episodes.synopsis: Ichika struggles to be her usual cheerful self when her mother returns home unexpectedly.
episodes.title: Hold Back the Tears! The Reason for Ichika's Smile!

episodes.synopsis: The girls are sent a hundred years into Ichigozaka's past, where they witness the extent of Noir's evil... and meet the Precure of old!
episodes.title: Kirakira Sparkle, Six Unique Traits! Kirakiral Creamer!

episodes.synopsis: Noir's most loyal servant, Diable, is sowing discord among the citizens of Ichigozaka... and he's using sweets to do it?!
episodes.title: Sweets Are Dangerous?! The Animal of Darkness Reawakens!!

episodes.synopsis: In circumstances as capricious as she is, Yukari is turned into a cat! Soon, she finds herself caught up in a turf war between the feral cats and fairies of Mt. Ichigozaka!
episodes.title: A Little Grudge Match! Cat Yukari vs. Fairy Kirarin!

episodes.synopsis: Awkward Himari finds herself questioning her friendship with Aoi while attending a high-society party. But soon, all of the guests are at each other's throats!
episodes.title: Complementary Tastes! Himari and Aoi!

episodes.synopsis: The annual Ichigozaka Games bring out the competitive spirit in everyone, but the athletic Akira is particularly determined to make a good showing for her neighborhood.
episodes.title: Ichika and Akira! The Great Ichigozaka Games!

episodes.synopsis: Ciel's sponsor has come all the way from Paris to demand that she return! Can the girls convince the demanding Madame Selene of Ichigozaka's quiet appeal?
episodes.title: Salut! Ciel's Going Back to France?!

episodes.synopsis: Pekorin wakes up one night... to find out she's turned into a human?! Proud to finally get to do things she could never do before, she heads out on her first real errand.
episodes.title: Pekorin's a Person, Peko!

episodes.synopsis: While the girls try to convince the other fairy tribes to join their fight against Noir, Glaive returns... with his nastiest trick yet!
episodes.title: Aw, No! Precure's Enemy Is Ichigozaka?!

episodes.synopsis: The Precures' efforts to save the citizens of Ichigozaka continue to fail in the face of Glaive's darkness. What can possibly save them?!
episodes.title: Let's la Costume-Change! Sweets Castle, Ready to Serve!

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious kirakiral thief terrorizing Ichigozaka turns out to be Elysio's latest plan to tear Ciel's family apart.
episodes.title: Dreams Are Kira-Pika Infinite!

episodes.synopsis: Aoi struggles to figure out what to do when Wild Azur's leader and lyricist reveals that he has to quit the band.
episodes.title: Sing It Out, Wow! Aoi's Last Song!

episodes.synopsis: Himari decides to test how much she's changed in the past year by auditioning for a cooking show.
episodes.title: The Secret Ingredient Is Courage! Himari's Recipe for the Future!

episodes.synopsis: When Miku goes missing from the hospital, Akira is driven to desperation searching for her.
episodes.title: Feelings Hidden in the Snow! Shout Out Your Love, Akira!

episodes.synopsis: Yukari makes a rare suggestion: the KiraPâti should host a Christmas party! But an announcement about her future threatens to bring down the merry mood...
episodes.title: Farewell, Yukari! The Thrilling Sweets Christmas!

episodes.synopsis: With life about to take them in separate directions, the girls decide to hold a birthday party for Ichika.
episodes.title: The Big Battle with Noir! A Birthday Without Smiles!

episodes.synopsis: Elysio's desire for perfect control locks the Precures in a world without love or hate. The only one who can save them is... Pekorin?!
episodes.title: Return the Love! Cure Pekorin, Ready to Serve!

episodes.synopsis: The Precures make one last desperate stand to convince Elysio of the importance of love.
episodes.title: The Final Battle! The Whole World, Let's la Mix-It-Up!

episodes.synopsis: Before they go their separate ways, the KiraPâti girls face one last threat, with a little help from a mysterious stranger.
episodes.title: Go Where Love Takes You! Whip, Step, Jump!

episodes.synopsis: Seven years after a mysterious woman named Milo saved him and his friends, Daisuke's still training and waiting for disaster to strike. Finally it does.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: She doesn't know him, but Milo conscripts Daisuke to fight the revision attacking the school. Shibuya officials try to figure out the situation.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: It's the year 2388 and the world has fallen to a pandemic. Milo tells Daisuke and his friends what she knows about the past. Later, they find trouble.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Muta declares that the revisions will send a list of people back to 2017 in return for the String Puppets. An unhappy Daisuke meets a revision.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: With Muta in jail and the police in charge, the S.D.S. continues to train. Daisuke thinks he's the leader, but Kuroiwa wants Gai to take on that role.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Marimari confronts Milo in the ruins of the birthday party, demanding to know the truth about the revisions. Daisuke's uncle escapes custody.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: With Daisuke in a holding cell, Kuroiwa and the others find out more about the revisions and what AHRV knows. Milo swears that they can return home.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Daisuke and the squad set out on a mission to rescue the hostages and destroy the artificial quantum brain -- but the revisions are ready for them.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: In the wake of Keisaku's actions, the surviving revisions retool their plan. While the S.D.S. is in disarray, Muta's supporters make their move.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Milo informs everyone that it's almost time for her to go to 2010, but not before she participates in the battle against Mukyu at Shibuya station.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: The team listens to a message from Milo revealing the truth about AHRV. The String Puppets are out of energy and Shibuya is running low on hope.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Shibuya's people are overjoyed when the reversion works, but there's a cost. Nicholas jumps back in time, and Daisuke confronts him and Milo in 2010.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Daisuke Dojima, 17 anni, al secondo anno dell’accademia Seisho, è sopravvissuto ad un rapimento da bambino, durante il quale era stato salvato da una misteriosa donna di nome Milo. Milo gli aveva rivelato la seguente profezia: “un giorno incorrerai in grave pericolo, quando ciò accadrà, tu sarai l’unico a poter proteggere tutti quanti”. Daisuke ha creduto ciecamente alle parole della sua salvatrice, così ha vissuto ossessivamente la sua vita in attesa di quel momento. Nessuno dei suoi amici gli ha creduto e nel tempo molti lo hanno allontanato, credendolo pazzo. Un giorno la profezia si compie: accade il misterioso fenomeno conosciuto come “Shibuya Drift”, l'intera area centrale del quartiere si solleva in aria e viene trasportata di 300 anni in un futuro post-apocalittico dove verranno subito attaccati da degli esseri denominati 'revisions', che controllano enormi ed ostili mostri meccanici. Ora i ragazzi dovranno combattere il “futuro” per far tornare il “presente”… devono tornare a casa ad ogni costo.

info.synopsis: Dopo aver raggiunto una terribile nomea in quanto Gran Maestro fondatore della Scuola Demoniaca, seminando terrore e morte, Wei Wuxian è finalmente sconfitto da un’alleanza di potenti Clan guidati dal suo Shidi. Si risveglia, però, tredici anni dopo, nel corpo di un giovane pazzo ed ha così una nuova occasione per essere ancora una volta vittima ed eroe del pericoloso ed affascinante mondo dei Cultori. Dovrà evitare di essere riconosciuto ma non sarà facile; uno dei primissimi incontri è proprio una vecchia conoscenza : Lan WangJi, un brillante Cultore con il quale ha un complicato rapporto di attrazione, incomprensione… e odio. I due si ritrovano di nuovo insieme, spinti ad allearsi contro un misterioso, subdolo nemico. Wei WuXian ora ha una nuova vita per risalire il baratro in cui era caduto e riunirsi ai suoi cari… e un vecchio compagno di avventure che scoprirà più vicino al suo cuore di quanto si aspettasse.
info.title: The Master of Diabolism Q

info.synopsis: Il film è ambientato in una certa isola, più precisamente in una scuola media, il giorno prima del festival della cultura. Un ragazzo lascia il baseball e ha un litigio con il suo migliore amico, ma all’improvviso incontra una misteriosa ragazza dagli occhi rossi chiamata Noruda, ed ecco un terribile tifone che distrugge la scuola.
info.title: Typhoon Noruda

episodes.synopsis: キャンベル星人が永い眠りから覚め、ついに地球を侵略し始めた。南原博士はこの事態を事前に察知し、対抗手段として巨大ロボット「コン・バトラーV」を準備していた。そしてパイロットとして、日本の各所から優秀な人材を集める。しかし、突然集められた５人の若者達は戦闘に戸惑い、ピンチに。５人の心を合わせないとコン・バトラーVには合体できないのだ。
episodes.title: Gli eroi del Combattler

episodes.synopsis: 全ての物質を自分と同化させてしまう新たなどれい獣ゾンビの攻撃に、コン・バトラーVの武器は使用不能となってしまった。追い詰められたコン・バトラーVに、ゾンビの魔の手が迫る！
episodes.title: La vendetta di Malik

episodes.synopsis: どれい獣ゼンダの猛攻にチームワークを乱されたコン・バトラーVは、全滅の危機に陥る。大将軍ガルーダが命じた十文字加速戦法とは何か？
episodes.title: I gemelli spaziali

episodes.synopsis: 怒る大将軍ガルーダは、どれい獣デモーラの溶解液を以ってコン・バトラーVの行動力を奪ってしまった。迫り来るデモーラにコン・バトラーVが叩きつけた必殺の新兵器とは？！
episodes.title: Un'arma divertente

episodes.synopsis: ガルーダの前線基地攻撃を目前に、突然、小介がチームから離れてしまった。このままではコンバインできない…。このときとばかりどれい獣ラセツは恐るべき怪力で襲い掛かる。急げ小介、みんなが危ない！
episodes.title: Rischio scampato

episodes.synopsis: ついに大将軍ガルーダは自ら姿を地上に現し、豹馬の弱点を突く最も卑劣な人質作戦で襲い掛かってきた。自らの命を投げ出して人質となる豹馬に発砲するガルーダ。手傷を負った豹馬の運命は…？
episodes.title: L'invincibile Roy

episodes.synopsis: どれい獣イカゲラとの決戦を前に、突然、豹馬が倒れてしまった。恐るべき暗殺者に約束された大将軍ガルーダの褒美とは何か？立ち上がれ豹馬！今、絶体絶命の危機が迫る！
episodes.title: Il diabolico Frankstone

episodes.synopsis: ついにガルーダの手は基地の中へも伸びてきた。防御バリアーを破壊し、ちずるを人質に取ったどれい人の正体は何か？ためらう十三に四ッ谷博士の命令が叩きつけられた…「あいつを撃て！
episodes.title: Attacco alla base

episodes.synopsis: 地下駐車場に出現した巨大な卵は何を意味するのか？どれい獣キールの猛攻撃に南原コネクションは大損害を受けてしまった。戦う豹馬たちを嘲笑うガルーダの狙いはどこに？！
episodes.title: Il cucciolo del mostro

episodes.synopsis: どれい獣ゲルドンの「日本列島切断計画」が開始された。反撃に飛び立ったコン・バトラー隊員。だが、突如コンバインメーターがメチャメチャに！
episodes.title: Dingo s'innamora

episodes.synopsis: どれい獣コングリラの攻撃を前に、突然豹馬は操縦不能となってしまった。みんなに迷惑はかけられない－ただひとり苦痛に耐える、豹馬の隠された秘密はなにか？ハンドルを握る手に今、血が滲む。
episodes.title: Fiducia riconquistata

episodes.synopsis: ついにガルーダは大将軍の誇りをかけて豹馬に挑戦する。恐るべきキャンベル星流の決闘とは…？二人が激突するとき、どれい獣ダイバのレーザークロスが閃く！立ち上がったのは、豹馬か、ガルーダか？
episodes.title: Il duello

episodes.synopsis: 再会の喜びもつかの間、豹馬と由美はどれい人に包囲されてしまう。大将軍ガルーダの二面作戦とは何か？隙を突いて南原コネクションに襲い掛かるどれい獣スペクトルダ。危うし、コン・バトラーV！
episodes.title: Campionessa di motociclismo

episodes.synopsis: 大将軍ガルーダは、卑怯にも国連総長を人質に、コン・バトラーVの爆破を命令する。南原コネクションにセットされた自爆装置の秘密とは何か？反抗する豹馬たちの頭上に今、国防軍の砲撃が炸裂した！
episodes.title: Distruggete la base!

episodes.synopsis: キャンベル星からの脱走者、コスモの行く手に待ち受けるものは何か？前線基地建設を企む大将軍ガルーダはどれい獣バリバリを出動させた。陸の孤島と化した都会に、コン・バトラーVの怒りの炎が燃え上がる！
episodes.title: La piccola aliena

episodes.synopsis: 豹馬すら手を焼く腕白坊主・飛田小太郎のために、南原コネクションは大混乱！どれい獣ゲルゾの攻撃を前に、コン・バトラーVはコンバイン不可能となってしまった。無断発進した1号機を追って、豹馬のオートバイが突っ走る！
episodes.title: Emergenza!

episodes.synopsis: 遊園地を襲った悪魔の正体は何か？突然逮捕された豹馬達に犯人という濡れ衣が着せられた。絶体絶命のピンチに四ッ谷博士が狙った大逆転計画とは？
episodes.title: Il falso Combattler

episodes.synopsis: ついに大将軍ガルーダは全世界へ宣戦布告を発した。出動を拒否する巨人・ガルガンチュワの隠された秘密は何か？3体のどれい獣に囲まれ、コン・バトラーVは大苦戦に陥る。
episodes.title: Questioni d'orgoglio

episodes.synopsis: 阿蘇山大噴火に隠された秘密とは何か？行方不明の家族を求めて大作のタンクが大洞窟を突進する！コン・バトラーVを襲う巨大な花の正体は？今、大将軍ガルーダの太陽炉がその姿を地上に現した。
episodes.title: Prigionieri!

episodes.synopsis: 四ッ谷博士を狙うキャンベル星の恐るべき黒い罠。大将軍ガルーダが掴んだコン・バトラーVの弱点とは何か？どれい獣ガニガマラを迎え撃つ豹馬達に今、新たな危機が迫る！
episodes.title: Il rapimento del professore

episodes.synopsis: コン・バトラーVをどれい獣アルファの三つの武器が襲う。水中に待ち受ける大将軍ガルーダの恐るべき罠の正体は何か？迫り来る絶体絶命の危機を今、５人のチームワークが跳ね返す！
episodes.title: Battaglia marina

episodes.synopsis: コンバインを前に、突然豹馬が編隊を離れてしまった。２万年の眠りから醒めた巨大な冷凍獣アイラスの正体は何か？大将軍ガルーダの卑怯な作戦に、怒りの超電磁スピンが炸裂する！
episodes.title: Orfano dello spazio

episodes.synopsis: のどかな牧場に、十三を狙った黒い影の正体は何か。人質を取られ、コン・バトラーVは今、戦闘不能の危機に陥った。卑劣な大将軍ガルーダに、怒りのライフルが火を噴く！
episodes.title: Amicizia tradita

episodes.synopsis: 突然コンバインアウトした、ちずるの隠された病とは何か？隙を突かれ、どれい獣イソギランの巨大な口にマリンが捕らえられてしまった。コンバインできないバトルチームに、大将軍ガルーダの笑い声が響く。
episodes.title: Coraggio da leonessa

episodes.synopsis: ついに大将軍ガルーダは最高司令官の地位を解任されてしまった。どれい獣デモンを操るミーアの隠された正体とは何か？地下基地を発見したコン・バトラーVに、今、反撃のチャンスが訪れる！
episodes.title: La tragedia del generale

episodes.synopsis: コン・バトラーVの前に立ち塞がる巨大なロボットの正体は何か？大将軍ガルーダの怒りはついに爆発した。今、大地底海に決戦の嵐が吹き荒れる！最後に残るものはコン・バトラーVか、大将軍ガルーダか？！
episodes.title: La caduta dell'impero

episodes.synopsis: 燃えたぎる溶岩の中から恐るべきマグマ獣が出現する…。ダンゲル、ワルキメデス、二人の将軍を指揮する女帝ジャネラとは何者か?戦うコン・バトラーVに今、キャンベル星の新たな挑戦が開始された…。
episodes.title: Attacco su due fronti

episodes.synopsis: ついにコン・バトラーVは全ての武器を封じられてしまった。襲い掛かるマグマ獣に叩きつける四ッ谷博士のパワーアップ計画とは何か？！女帝ジャネラの挑戦に、豹馬たちは最大のピンチに立たされる！
episodes.title: Lotta alla cieca

episodes.synopsis: 南原コネクションを狙うワルキメデスの作戦とは何か？金太と知恵の登場に、豹馬たちはすっかりペースを乱されてしまった。不意を突かれたコン・バトラーVに、マグマ獣ザクロスのドリルが迫る！
episodes.title: Piccoli eroi

episodes.synopsis: 次々と南原コネクションを直撃する巨大な地震の正体とは何か？マグマ獣ブルンゲンの攻撃に、コン・バトラーVは分解寸前に追い込まれる。絶体絶命の危機を珍メカ・ケロットの新兵器が打ち砕く！
episodes.title: Un prezioso alleato

episodes.synopsis: ついに超電磁力を奪われ、コン・バトラーは戦闘不能となってしまった。南原コネクションを攻撃するマグマ獣モグマの隠された能力とは何か？地底深く偵察に出動した小介の５号機に、今、絶体絶命の危機が迫る！
episodes.title: Ladri di energia

episodes.synopsis: マグマ獣マンモズの攻撃を受け、南原コネクションは凍り付いてしまった。負傷をおして戦うちづるに今、ツララ弾の集中射撃が炸裂する！上半身を凍結されたコン・バトラーVの大逆転作戦とは何か？！
episodes.title: Il grande gelo

episodes.synopsis: コン・バトラーＶをワルキメデスの新兵器「コロナクラッシュ」が襲う！炎と化したマグマ獣ファイアンの攻撃に、四ッ谷博士が重傷を負ってしまった。絶体絶命の危機に出現する2体のコン・バトラーＶに隠された秘密とは何か…？
episodes.title: Il gemello pasticcione

episodes.synopsis: 南原博士の亡霊が、コン・バトラーＶを謎の秘密基地に誘う。マグマ獣プテラギラスの奇襲攻撃に隠されたワルキメデスの罠とは何か？閉じ込められた四ッ谷博士達に、今、灼熱の溶岩流が迫る!
episodes.title: Prigionieri di Janera

episodes.synopsis: 嵐の中に豹馬達が見たものは、破壊された南原コネクションの姿だった。四ッ谷博士を人質に、全面降伏を迫るワルキメデスの作戦とは何か?今、ギリギリに追いつめられたコン・バトラーに絶体絶命の危機が迫る!
episodes.title: Nessuna risposta della base!

episodes.synopsis: 戦闘の最中に、突然十三の目が見えなくなってしまった。コンバイン出来ない豹馬たちをマグマ獣ドローンの分身が襲う。追いつめられたコン・バトラーＶの頭上にサーベルアームが叩きつけられる！
episodes.title: Regalo di natale

episodes.synopsis: 南原コネクション内に、突如マグマ獣デメカゼラが出現する。イスマニア女王の華麗なる招待状に隠された恐るべき罠の正体はなにか？豹馬達に迫る絶体絶命の危機を、今、ケロットが打ち砕く!
episodes.title: Una cascata di diamanti

episodes.synopsis: 突然、湖に出現したカエルの大群が、巨大なメカガエルに変身する。ロペットが捕らえられ、豹馬たちはコンバイン不可能となってしまった。マグマ獣フロッギーの攻撃にコネクションは全滅の危機にさらされる。
episodes.title: L'attacco delle rane meccaniche

episodes.synopsis: 火山の爆発と共に出現するマグマ獣ダコンダーの狙いは何か？今、南原コネクションに恐るべき赤熱の溶岩が迫る。絶体絶命の危機を跳ね飛ばす大作の奮闘に、虎子おばさんの檄が飛ぶ！
episodes.title: Doppia minaccia

episodes.synopsis: 恐るべしコピーマシンの魔の手がバトルチームのメンバーを狙う。戦闘の最中、突然コンバインを解いてしまった南原ちずるの正体は何か?マグマ獣マリオネラのトリックを豹馬たちのチームワークが打ち破る!
episodes.title: La sostituzione

episodes.synopsis: ひとつの町ぐるみ、四ッ谷博士が恐怖のバリアーで捕らえられてしまった。闘うことの出来ないコン・バトラーＶをマグマ獣ドリンガーが襲う。人質を弄ぶワルキメデスに、豹馬の怒りの炎が燃え上がる！
episodes.title: Una città in ostaggio

episodes.synopsis: 南原コネクションに送り込まれた黒い魔の手の正体は何か?！マグマ獣ハリネズラーの攻撃を前に、時限爆弾の罠が豹馬を襲う。手段を選ばぬ卑劣なワルキメデスに、怒りの超電磁スピンが炸裂する！
episodes.title: Una sicaria per Roy

episodes.synopsis: 突如2頭の超獣に襲われ、豹馬が重傷を負ってしまった。コネクション攻撃と引き換えに豹馬を要求する女帝ジャネラの狙いは何か？身代わりとなって闘う南原ちずるのピンチを、バトルチームの友情が救う！
episodes.title: Il ruggito del pericolo

episodes.synopsis: 恐怖の毒ガスに包まれたコン・バトラーＶに最期の時が迫る！サイボーグと化したマグマ獣マザーンの隠された正体は何か？絶体絶命の危機をケロットの珍作戦が打ち砕く！
episodes.title: Operazione cyborg

episodes.synopsis: 超電磁スピンを破るワルキメデスの新たな作戦とは何か？エネルギーゼロとなったコン・バトラーＶをマグマ獣スカルプの二段攻撃が襲う。コンバインアウトした豹馬たちの頭上に連続攻撃の恐怖が炸裂する。
episodes.title: La nuova arma di Walkimer

episodes.synopsis: 国連に向かったバトルチームをワルキメデスの黒い魔の手が待ち受ける。歓迎の舞踏会に隠された恐るべき暗殺者の正体は何か？コンバインを急ぐ豹馬とちずるに女帝ジャネラの炎が襲い掛かった。
episodes.title: Il controllo dei cervelli

episodes.synopsis: 突如、将軍ダンゲルが降伏をしてきた。その裏に隠された恐るべきワルキメデスの作戦とは何か？キャンベル星の秘密基地に突入した豹馬たちを謎の爆発が閉じ込めてしまった。コネクションに仕掛けられた時限爆弾に、今、爆発のときが迫る！
episodes.title: Il pentimento di Dunkel

episodes.synopsis: コンバイン寸前のバトルメカに恐怖の爆弾が取り付く。キャンベル星の頭脳とか学力が結集したロボット・サキューンの秘密は何か？のけ者にされたダンゲルの怒りがワルキメデスの作戦を狂わす。
episodes.title: Un segreto da conservare

episodes.synopsis: 死神との再会が父母を失った豹馬の過去を蘇らせる…。突如、四ッ谷博士が編成した「第２コン・バトラー隊」の持つ意味は何か？マグマ獣イカロスタの攻撃にバトルチームはコンバインを封じられてしまった…。
episodes.title: Nemici d'infanzia

episodes.synopsis: 突然音波攻撃を受け、ロペットのコントロールが麻痺してしまった。ダンゲルすら利用するワルキメデスの囮作戦とは何か？マグマ獣スネーグルの攻撃を前に、豹馬たちはコンバインアウトの危機に陥る。
episodes.title: Il cobra a tre teste

episodes.synopsis: 突如ライフル魔事件の犯人として、十三が逮捕されてしまった。コンバイン不可能となったバトルチームをマグマ獣ハゲネズラが襲う。包囲するロボット群に隠されたワルキメデスの新たな作戦とは何か？
episodes.title: I sosia assassini

episodes.synopsis: 自らの死を賭けた、将軍ダンゲルの猛攻撃がついに開始された！コン・バトラーＶを追い詰めるマグマ獣グレードの２つの体とは何か？女帝ジャネラの嘲笑が、壮烈な豹馬との対決を打ち砕く！
episodes.title: La morte di Dunkel

episodes.synopsis: ダンゲルを失った屈辱に、女帝ジャネラの怒りが燃え上がった！南原コネクションを攻撃するマグマ獣スプロンの二面作戦とは何か？コン・バトラーＶを救う四ッ谷博士の決断を、今、爆発の恐怖が襲う！
episodes.title: Ultimo attacco alla Terra

episodes.synopsis: 全てを賭けた女帝ジャネラの総攻撃が地獄の炎を噴き上げる！コン・バトラーＶの怒りがマグマ獣の大編隊に叩きつけられる。最後の時を迎えた豹馬たちに、キャンベル星の使いがもたらしたものは…？
episodes.title: Il salvataggio della Terra

info.synopsis: Gli abitanti del pianeta Campbell, guidati dall'ambizioso generale Malik, invadono la Terra. Il professor Stevens, a capo di un avanzato laboratorio di ricerca, costruisce il robot gigante Combattler per difendere il pianeta, gigante d'acciaio che si forma dall'agganciamento di cinque veicoli pilotati da altrettanti piloti ciascuno dotato di un'abilità particolare.
info.title: Combattler V (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: Karin Kokubu rescues a yellow piglet on her way to school. The piglet turns out to be the prince of an alien planet, though, and turns her into the super-pig Buurin- but she'd rather be any other kind of hero.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Karin's school is having an important soccer match with a rival school, one known for their unfair tricks. Koichi, the star player of her school's team, is going to be the victim of these tricks unless Buurin does something about it.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Karin and her best friend Masami have a falling-out during tennis practice. Having a hard time making up, Karin decides to use Buurin to repair their relationship.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: A local park is hosting a female pro-wrestling tournament. Among the wrestlers is an amateur, Buutan, who dresses up like Buurin to fight.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Karin's school's athletic meet is hosting a very special event: a tug-of-war match where all of the first-year students compete with Buurin. Koichi is having trouble organizing the event, though.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: On a history field trip, Karin finds an ancient clay figure that looks a lot like Buurin. It leads her to some ruins that give some insight into Buurin's history.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: A real bank robber interrupts a live show starring Cutey Chao, Karin's favorite heroine. Buurin must stop him quickly.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Karin has been eating a lot lately, but after a comment from Koichi she decides to go on a diet. She goes too far, though, and gets weaker and weaker- this soon starts affecting Buurin's performance as well.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: The race circuit that Keiko Kuroha's family owns is hosting a solar car race. Karin and some of her friends enter a Buurin-shaped car in the race, driven by Ms. Tateshi. When the weather takes a turn for the worse, the situation becomes tense.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Shinichiro Kokobu, editor-in-chief of the Akebono Times (and Karin's father), is on the hunt for a big scoop. He has a new target that he's doing some investigative journalism on- Buurin!
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: The school's cultural festival includes a 'best couple' contest. Lured in by the promise of a romantic meal for the winning couple, Karin tries to win with Koichi.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Kashiwagi has been really into the supernatural lately, and things are dialed up a notch when a series of coincidences leads him to believe that he has supernatural powers of his own.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: As Karin prepares for a big test, she finds out that Ton has a test as well. If Buurin doesn't collect 50 pearls by the deadline, Ton won't be able to become king of Buuringo.
episodes.title: Episodio 13

episodes.synopsis: Koichi's making a movie, and he and the others have a perfect pick for the lead actress: Buurin!
episodes.title: Episodio 14

episodes.synopsis: Kaoru, disheartened by littering citizens who won't change their ways, decides to take the task of picking up garbage into her own hands. Buurin ends up helping her.
episodes.title: Episodio 15

episodes.synopsis: Karin is looking forward to giving Koichi a gift at a Christmas party. He says he can't come, though. Karin is suspicious- he says the reason is that he has a date with Buurin!
episodes.title: Episodio 16

episodes.synopsis: Karin comes across an opportunity to see if her future is with Koichi.
episodes.title: Episodio 17

episodes.synopsis: There's a big New Years' party at Karin's place! All seems well, but Ton is shut in Karin's room, missing his home planet.
episodes.title: Episodio 18

episodes.synopsis: Karin and Koichi get to go (with the rest of their class) to a ski camp. Mr. Arashiyama seems nervous and soon enough Karin finds out he wants to profess his love to Ms. Tateshi.
episodes.title: Episodio 19

episodes.synopsis: There's a cool plant in the school (and it's named after Keiko). Trouble arises when the plant grows out of control and Buurin must defeat it.
episodes.title: Episodio 20

episodes.synopsis: Karin faces complicated feelings towards Koichi and wonders who he likes.
episodes.title: Episodio 21

episodes.synopsis: Ton is in love, and not with someone back on his home planet, either.
episodes.title: Episodio 22

episodes.synopsis: It's valentines' day, and. Buurin is helping a local sweets shop to deliver chocolates around town. As orders pile up, she worries she won't even have time to give chocolate to Koichi before the day is over.
episodes.title: Episodio 23

episodes.synopsis: Karin's father waits for a natural phenomenon to occur.
episodes.title: Episodio 24

episodes.synopsis: Karin has to choose a doll for Girl's day. She's conflicted about which to choose, though.
episodes.title: Episodio 25

episodes.synopsis: Buurin and tennis intersect.
episodes.title: Episodio 26

episodes.synopsis: Buurin needs to recharge, but has to rescue a puppy and stays transformed for a bit too long, then faces the consequences.
episodes.title: Episodio 27

episodes.synopsis: Karin's younger brother has a girlfriend, Hitomi. All is fine until Karin finds out Hitomi has a familiar older brother, one who stood against Koichi's soccer team a while back...
episodes.title: Episodio 28

episodes.synopsis: Keiko funds a class trip to Hawaii.
episodes.title: Episodio 29

episodes.synopsis: A rumor concerning Buurin is spreading in Hawaii.
episodes.title: Episodio 30

episodes.synopsis: Nobody seems to want to run for student council president this year... until Keiko Kuroha steps up to the challenge and throws the entire school into election spirit.
episodes.title: Episodio 31

episodes.synopsis: Jimmy Matsumoto has a turbulent history with the annual cherry trees.
episodes.title: Episodio 32

episodes.synopsis: The cold is going through town again, and this time Karin (and by extension, Buurin) gets it. It begins to interfere with Buurin's superheroine activities.
episodes.title: Episodio 33

episodes.synopsis: Koichi's soccer team faces a big game, but there's some conflict between the players. Mr. Arashiyama says that carp streamers could bring them back together, though.
episodes.title: Episodio 34

episodes.synopsis: Two ninjas working for Takuma's family kidnap Karin and take her to Kyoto, where her friends shortly follow. Takuma believes that Karin is in love with him.
episodes.title: Episodio 35

episodes.synopsis: Karin gets to help out with rice planting, but it seems tough.
episodes.title: Episodio 36

episodes.synopsis: Koichi has written a love letter to Buurin. Karin, determined to make Koichi fall in love with her as herself instead, tries to prevent Buurin and Koichi from ever meeting again.
episodes.title: Episodio 37

episodes.synopsis: Jimmy sees Buuringo in the sky and, while trying to investigate, falls into another dimension, creating a series of strange circumstances.
episodes.title: Episodio 38

episodes.synopsis: Everywhere Buurin appears, one strange mark can be found. Karin and Ton head to Kyoto in order to investigate the connection between the mark and the Mushanokoji family.
episodes.title: Episodio 39

episodes.synopsis: Kashiwagi's grandmother had the chance to become Buurin as well a long time ago.
episodes.title: Episodio 40

episodes.synopsis: Jimmy's investigations reach their end and he has a theory: Karin and Buurin are the same person! Karin must convince him that he's wrong, somehow.
episodes.title: Episodio 41

episodes.synopsis: Just as Jimmy is about to confirm his theory, another Buurin appears! This new Buurin is fast, strong, and smart- no one seems to know who she is, and to prove herself as the one real Buurin, the original and the impostor have a showdown.
episodes.title: Episodio 42

episodes.synopsis: Karin and friends spend a night in the gym basement. Mr. Arashiyama and Karin both have something to hide, so they fake supernatural happenings.
episodes.title: Episodio 43

episodes.synopsis: Keiko Kuroha has found a strange compact. As it turns out, it's the very same compact that Karin uses to transform into Buurin!
episodes.title: Episodio 44

episodes.synopsis: Karin finally gets the chance to (temporarily) transform into Cutey Chao! In a strange twist of fate, though, Buurin is needed, and so she has to transform back.
episodes.title: Episodio 45

episodes.synopsis: Ton and Karin might have to break up their friendship as Karin moves in on her goal of 108 pearls.
episodes.title: Episodio 46

episodes.synopsis: Keiko is having a dinner party at her massive, luxurious mansion. It turns out, though, that her parents only come home once a year.
episodes.title: Episodio 47

episodes.synopsis: An entrance in a basement leads to another world.
episodes.title: Episodio 48

tmdb.synopsis: During a VESPER staff review of Mahoro's life and activities following her entry into civilian life, a letter from Mahoro is read to the assembled officers. In it, she describes taking part in a "summer vacation group research trip" to explore the notorious "nine mysteries" of Hiryu School 4. Seven of these are generally acknowledged to be no more than standard rumors typical of any school; the remaining two, however, have not been as easy to put to rest. Of course what Suguru, Kiyomi and Toshiya don't know is that all through, the three girls, minus Mahoro, are playing them, as part and parcel of their own "human response to stress" research project. But seek, and ye shall find: it does not take much to send them running frantically through the school to get away from "red-haired Ando", according to legend, a girl who fell to her death from the school roof years ago and has been haunting the halls at night ever since. Mahoro herself is in on the joke, though she plays along. The twist, however, comes when, after becoming separated from the group, she comes across the real Ando, a ghost or spirit trapped in the school until she can confess her love to a boy whose own spirit is trapped in another part of the building. Reunited by Mahoro, the two ghosts, now freed - and together - disappear, and the letter concludes.

Of course what Suguru, Kiyomi and Toshiya don't know is that all through, the three girls, minus Mahoro, are playing them, as part and parcel of their own "human response to stress" research project. But seek, and ye shall find: it does not take much to send them running frantically through the school to get away from "red-haired Ando", according to legend, a girl who fell to her death from the school roof years ago and has been haunting the halls at night ever since. The twist, however, comes when, after becoming separated from the group, she comes across the real Ando, a ghost or spirit trapped in the school until she can confess her love to a boy whose own spirit is trapped in another part of the building. Reunited by Mahoro, the two ghosts, now freed - and together - disappear, and the letter concludes.

tmdb.synopsis: As the number of contacts between SAINT and humans increases, VESPER officers agree that alone and stripped of most of her combat capabilities, Mahoro is in danger. To counteract this threat, her combat support mech unit, V1046-R9 Slash Zero, is authorized to join her in the human world. In the meanwhile, the Hiryu town Summer Festival is fast approaching. Each year, the leading citizens of the town select one girl to be featured in the hours-long Dance of the Dead, a grueling performance that pushes one to the limits of her abilities and endurance. This year, Mahoro is the one chosen. In the few days remaining before the Festival, then, she is occupied almost entirely with pracicing the dance. The question of what to wear for the event, which calls for traditional clothing, is answered when Suguru pulls his his mother's yukata and Cmdr. Misato's kimono out of storage. After extensive practice, Mahoro performs magnificently, dancing nonstop for three hours and eleven minutes. According to one of the residents, hers is the best dance in at least a decade. Following the conclusion of it, her and Saori, herself chosen to perform several years earlier, engage in some not-so-friendly "competition" at the various festival booths, with Suguru as the prize - which leads, in short order, to both of them being banned. As the festival comes to a close with a fireworks display, Suguru remarks that this is the first time since the death of his parents that he has been able to actually enjoy himself. In due time, as him and Mahoro rejoin the rest of Suguru's classmates to watch the fireworks, he asks Mahoro to come to the festival next year, as well. Knowing what he still does not, though, she pauses. Her answer, "it'd be nice to come again," - nothing more, and nothing less.

tmdb.synopsis: The summer vacation comes to an end, and Suguru, Miyuki, Rin and the others return to school. On the very first day, as they are walking to class, Chizuko is nearly run down by an out-of-control car, but saved by a mysterious man who appears, seemingly out of nowhere, and leaves as quicky. Later in the day, the same man, Tou Ryuga, reappears again, as a substitute teacher hired by the school. But later still, at the mention of his name, Mahoro grows uneasy. The reason, revealed in the evening of the same day, is simple: much like Mahoro herself, Ryuga is a combat android, only in the service of the alien invaders SAINT. He attacks Mahoro as she is out shopping, and although Mahoro and Slash gain the upper hand, she feels that rather than being able to defeat Ryuga, she is merely being allowed to survive. Before he leaves, however, Ryuga declares his intention - to challenge Mahoro and make the final determination of which one of them is the better warrior. During Mahoro's active service, her and Ryuga engaged - inconclusively - several times. Now, though, the first step he takes is finding out just what the nature of the relationship between Mahoro and Suguru, whom he knows to the the son of Commander Ryoh Misato, is. It is to this effect that he infiltrates Suguru's school and interrogates his various friends. The responses are nothing but praise - and in the cases of Miyuki and Rin, blushing and mumbling - although unsurprisingly, Saori misinterprets the situation and perceives Ryoh as a rival for Suguru's affections. Later, Slash and Mahoro, who also infiltrate the school, challenge him. Mahoro threatens to fight Ryuga right there and then, if that would mean protecting Suguru. Whether he is truly concerned or simply looking for an excuse to put the battle off is not clear, but he declares that he is unwilling to fight in a location where civilians could be harmed, and leaves.

tmdb.synopsis: As SAINT combat android Tou Ryuga enters the lives of Suguru and his friends, disguised as a substitute teacher, Suguru becomes aware that some sort of connection exists between Ryuga and Mahoro. To further understand their relationship, Suguru invites all of his friends, as well as both Ryuga and Saori to a party at his house. At the same time, Mahoro is becoming more and more aware that her view of herself - as well as her relationship to Suguru - is changing the more she time she spends living with him. Originally, she saw herself as merely atoning for causing Commander Misato's death, but as the days go by, she comes to realize that what she is truly looking for is a place to belong, a home to be able to take care of and come back to, and people to care for. In contrast, Ryuga's self-examination shows that he sees his entire raison d'etre as fighting - and defeating - Mahoro. His entire identity is of a warrior who was defeated once but is desperate for a second chance, because without it, he is nothing. The party at Suguru's house, where Ryuga comes to realize that Suguru, despite suspecting the depth of Mahoro's past is still unaware of his role in it, sets the stage for the final confrontation between the two combat androids. However, Suguru's intervention means that the actual duel will take place two days later, in a mutually agreed-upon location. With the time and place of the duel now determined, Mahoro again faces the fact that Suguru still has no knowledge of her impending death. She has already caused him immeasurable pain once, and is left to wonder - it is worth living just a few more months with him if the end will still be same pain.

tmdb.synopsis: With the time and place of the final duel with Tou Ryuga now set, Mahoro really has nothing left to lose, and uses the opportunity to ask Suguru out on a "date" to Yokohama. The effect is predictable: both him and Saori are prompted to imagine all the romantic implications of such a situation, and of course, when Mahoro and Suguru finally depart, Saori is right there, pursuing them on her Vespa. It's an uneven match, but the woman certainly gets points for persistence... The "date" itself is absolutely idyllic, as per Mahoro's expectation of "fun, tea, fun, lunch...and then more fun!" - an amusement park trip, shopping, lunch, then the warm early fall evening at a park. And when she reveals Ryuga's true identity to Suguru, he is not particularly surprised. Later on still, as Sugur and Mahoro are gazing over the nighttime city, she tells him that since beginning to work at the house, she has been able to find happiness. But when in Suguru's reply, it is clear that he knows there is much more about her - and about her relationship to him - that she is not telling, Mahoro can't help but face the full weight of reality: her past, her loneliness, and the fact that she is very much living on borrowed time. Suguru then plays his hand and asks Mahoro to explain her past as a combat android when she feels she is able to do so. After they return home, Suguru, tired, goes off to bed, though despite being exhausted, he is unable to fall asleep and lies there, thinking. As soon as he heads out, though, Mahoro changes into her battle outfit and sets out for the duel with Ryuga, determined, however, to defeat him - and to come back alive...

tmdb.synopsis: As Mahoro and Ryuga face off in the final battle they both planned for, each has a person waiting for them: Suguru back at the Misato house and Sara in the SAINT spaceship in Earth orbit. Looking at the planet, Sara can't help but think about the irony of the way SAINT's ages-long quest for contact with another civilization has turned out, with mankind's response being the "most primitive" - war. For her own part, Mahoro again makes it clear that, although her original reason for deciding to live in the human world was to serve penance, in the months since, she has come to genuinely enjoy her existence within the ties of friendship that go along with being human. To the end, though, she also understands that there can be no other resolution to the opposition between her and Ryuga, and so, the battle is on. With her strength and capacity severely diminished after she was decomissioned, Mahoro is able to hold Ryuga off, but it is very obvious that the battle is not being fought on equal terms. As she exhausts her ammunition, without inflicting any noticeable damage, it is clear that if she is to survive, Mahoro must resort to far more drastic means. It is at this time, too, that Suguru, waking from a short nap in his room, comes downstairs and discovers a set dinner...and Mahoro's farewell letter. Within seconds, his mind is set; he needs to be wherever she is, regardless of what happens. Slash resists briefly, but cannot do so any further after Suguru explicitly invokes his status as Mahoro's - and by extension, his - "master," and issues a direct order to be taken to the location of the duel. Even though weakened, Mahoro still has a few tricks up her sleeve. A personal shielding system offers some protection, at least against projectiles, while several explosive charges, uniquely shaped like throwing knives to deceive an opponent destroy the building and force the fight outside, where Mahoro can draw on the power of one of her last remaining weapons. The anti-substance rail gun she fields really is a last-ditch weapon: cumbersome to fire, and requiring so much power that for a few seconds, the entire city power grid is drained. Of course it isn't like Mahoro is in a position to choose... ...Except, when the smoke clears, and Ryuga is still standing there, despite all hopes and expectations, Mahoro's options have in fact been exhausted. And whatever will be, will be...

tmdb.synopsis: Mahoro may be the Earth's greatest weapon, but human technology is still only so much; whatever the reasons and explanations, Ryuga does take a direct hit from an antimatter cannon...and shrugs it off. Mahoro is caught off guard, and her last thoughts before she blacks out are that if she somehow gets out of this alive, she still just might get back home before Sugur wakes up, destroy the note she left, and go on as if nothing at all happened. So black out she does, into her personal True Happiness that is a morning, any morning, cooking and ready to face the day. Of course it only gets better from there; Suguru suggests a picnic, and soon enough, the whole gang, Miyuki and Rin and Chizuko, Kiyomi and Toshiya, are at the door, yelling to Mahoro to come and join them...So just like on so many other sundays, a hillside picnic, a perfect day, friends, food, Shikijo-sensei the annoying, ridiculous...but familiar. Then, as the four girls are perched in a majestic tree looking over as much of the world as matters for them, the talk turns to dreams and aspirations. Sakura, Rin and Chizuko's answers are completely predictable, but as they turn to Mahoro with the same question - what it is that she dreams of - cue the end of the dream... And cue nothing but pain, as Mahoro snaps back into reality. But though she may be weakend and injured, on the brink of realizing that she may not be coming home after all, her and Ryuga both know she is still not at her limit. What Ryuga can't quite figure out, though, is why? And when he is about to unleash his own ultimate weapon - Ray Blade - all Mahoro does is stand there and wait for death to take her...because in the end, one death is the same as another. It is just at this moment, not a second too soon, really, that Suguru comes dashing into the middle of the fight. Like he said, he is all too aware he is not able to actually affect what happens in any real way...but that isn't the point; he does all he can - protects the one he cares for. And when Ryuga simply swats him out of the way, Mahoro, too, cannot merely stand aside. That which she would not do for herself, she will do for Suguru in an instant. The ultimate warrior, beaten but not defeated, charges up her ultimate weapon, which draws on her very life energy for its power - a one-shot suicide move - but if there ever was a time to use it, that time is now. As she charges towards him, and as Slash screams for her to stop, Ryuga snaps to a realization. In the end of all things, Mahoro did not care defeating him, even though she could have in a second. The only way for her to truly win would be if she survived. To protect Suguru, though, she is more than willing to give her own life. This way, the entire battle loses its meaning. There is no way Ryuga can truly "win"...and, instants before Mahoro is about to defeat him, the VESPER android lowers his sword... In the end, then, as Mahoro tells Suguru, the events of this one night end "like a dream." And as the two of them are flying home, Mahoro's happy tears glittering in the moonlight like so many stars, all Suguru asks is for her to never again go away without telling him. And, knowing what she knows, Mahoro's answer is "Okay. I will stay with you forever." What the full meaning of the seven words is will not be revealed until much later...

info.synopsis: Negli anni 80 l'umanità viene attaccata dagli alieni e per contrastarli viene fondata l'organizzazione Vesper. Il prodotto più potente di Vesper è l'androide V1046-R Mahoro, costruito utilizzando le tecnologie aliene, che si rivela la chiave di volta nella vittoria contro gli alieni. Il prolungato utilizzo di armi ad energia ha però ridotto la vita residua di Mahoro a 40 giorni, che possono essere portati a 400 con la rimozione delle armi installate nel suo corpo. Mahoro viene lasciata libera di vivere come vuole i suoi ultimi giorni, e decide di mettersi a servizio della famiglia Misato come cameriera. L'unico componente della famiglia Misato è Suguru, un ragazzino che frequenta le scuole medie ed è rimasto orfano e piuttosto introverso, anche se di animo gentile...
